prompt: Write a function `loadCoins(player: Player): (boolean, number | string)` that reads the player's coins from a DataStore named "Coins". Retry failed reads a few times. Return `true, coins` on success (0 only when nothing has been saved yet) and `false, errorMessage` when loading fails, so callers can never mistake a DataStore outage for an empty balance.
reference:
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local STORE_NAME = "Coins"
local MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(STORE_NAME)

-- Returns (true, coins) on success and (false, message) on failure.
-- A failed read must never look like 0 coins: if the caller later saved
-- that 0 it would wipe the player's real balance.
local function loadCoins(player: Player): (boolean, number | string)
	local key = tostring(player.UserId)
	local lastError = "unknown error"
	for attempt = 1, MAX_ATTEMPTS do
		local ok, value = pcall(function()
			return store:GetAsync(key)
		end)
		if ok then
			if value == nil then
				return true, 0 -- nothing saved yet: a genuinely new player
			elseif type(value) == "number" then
				return true, value
			end
			return false, "stored coin value is not a number"
		end
		lastError = tostring(value)
		if attempt < MAX_ATTEMPTS then
			task.wait(attempt)
		end
	end
	return false, lastError
end

return loadCoins

prompt: Write a client script that spins a part named Spinner in workspace every frame, frame-rate independently, and disconnects when the part goes away. The place uses StreamingEnabled, so the part may not be loaded yet and can stream out and back in.
reference:
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local SPEED = math.rad(90) -- radians per second
local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

local function stop()
	for _, connection in connections do
		connection:Disconnect()
	end
	table.clear(connections)
end

local function start(spinner: BasePart)
	stop()
	table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime: number)
		spinner.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, SPEED * deltaTime, 0)
	end))
	-- With StreamingEnabled the part can stream out (it leaves the DataModel
	-- without being destroyed) and later stream back in as a new instance.
	table.insert(connections, spinner.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
		if not spinner:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			stop()
		end
	end))
end

local function consider(child: Instance)
	if child.Name == "Spinner" and child:IsA("BasePart") then
		start(child)
	end
end

-- No WaitForChild without a timeout: under streaming the part may not exist
-- yet (or ever), so react to it arriving instead of blocking forever.
workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(consider)
local existing = workspace:FindFirstChild("Spinner")
if existing then
	consider(existing)
end

prompt: Create a RemoteEvent `ShoutMessage`. The server handler receives a message from a client, accepts only strings of 1-100 characters, allows one shout per second per player, filters the text with TextService and broadcasts the filtered result to every client. Clean up per-player state.
reference:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TextService = game:GetService("TextService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local MAX_LENGTH = 100
local COOLDOWN = 1

local shout = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
shout.Name = "ShoutMessage"
shout.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local lastShout = {} :: { [Player]: number }
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastShout[player] = nil
end)

shout.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, message: unknown)
	if typeof(message) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local length = utf8.len(message)
	if not length or length < 1 or length > MAX_LENGTH then
		return -- invalid UTF-8, empty or too long
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local previous = lastShout[player]
	if previous and now - previous < COOLDOWN then
		return
	end
	lastShout[player] = now
	-- Filtering yields and can throw; never broadcast unfiltered text.
	local ok, filtered = pcall(function()
		local result = TextService:FilterStringAsync(message, player.UserId)
		return result:GetNonChatStringForBroadcastAsync()
	end)
	if ok and player.Parent then
		shout:FireAllClients(player.UserId, filtered)
	end
end)

prompt:
Exploiters freeze this server script forever (and sometimes make it error). Explain why in a comment and rewrite it so a client can never stall or crash the server, keeping the same `askReady(player): boolean` API with a 5 second timeout:
```lua
local AskReady = game.ReplicatedStorage.AskReady -- RemoteFunction
local function askReady(player)
	return AskReady:InvokeClient(player)
end
return askReady
```
reference:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local REPLY_TIMEOUT = 5

-- InvokeClient lets a client hang the server thread forever (or error it).
-- Ask with a RemoteEvent and wait for the reply with a timeout instead.
local askEvent = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
askEvent.Name = "AskReady"
askEvent.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

local waiting: { [Player]: thread } = {}

askEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, ready: unknown)
	local thread = waiting[player]
	if not thread or typeof(ready) ~= "boolean" then
		return -- unsolicited or malformed reply
	end
	waiting[player] = nil
	task.spawn(thread, ready)
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	local thread = waiting[player]
	if thread then
		waiting[player] = nil
		task.spawn(thread, false)
	end
end)

local function askReady(player: Player): boolean
	if waiting[player] then
		return false -- one question at a time per player
	end
	local thread = coroutine.running()
	waiting[player] = thread
	task.delay(REPLY_TIMEOUT, function()
		if waiting[player] == thread then
			waiting[player] = nil
			task.spawn(thread, false)
		end
	end)
	askEvent:FireClient(player)
	return coroutine.yield()
end

return askReady

prompt: A client fires `DealDamage:FireServer(target, amount)`. Rewrite the server handler so a cheater cannot choose the damage or hit targets across the map.
reference:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local HIT_DAMAGE = 10
local HIT_RANGE = 10
local HIT_COOLDOWN = 0.5
local remote = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("DealDamage") :: RemoteEvent

local nextHitAt = {} :: { [Player]: number }
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	nextHitAt[player] = nil
end)

local function rootOf(model: Model?): BasePart?
	local part = model and model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
		return part
	end
	return nil
end

-- The client's `amount` is ignored entirely: damage is a server constant.
remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, target: unknown, _clientAmount: unknown)
	if not (typeof(target) == "Instance" and target:IsA("Model")) then
		return
	end
	local character = player.Character
	if target == character then
		return -- no self-hits
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now < (nextHitAt[player] or 0) then
		return -- still on cooldown
	end
	local attacker = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local victim = target:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not attacker or attacker.Health <= 0 or not victim or victim.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end
	local myRoot, theirRoot = rootOf(character), rootOf(target)
	if not myRoot or not theirRoot or (myRoot.Position - theirRoot.Position).Magnitude > HIT_RANGE then
		return
	end
	nextHitAt[player] = now + HIT_COOLDOWN
	victim:TakeDamage(HIT_DAMAGE)
end)

prompt: Implement saving for a player profile table that is safe against server shutdown: save on leave, autosave periodically, and wait for all saves in BindToClose. Load each player's profile when they join (including players already in the server). Load each player's profile when they join (including players already in the server).
reference:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")

local store = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("Profiles")
local AUTOSAVE_SECONDS = 60

type Profile = { coins: number, level: number }

local profiles = {} :: { [Player]: Profile }
local inFlight = 0

local function keyFor(player: Player): string
	return "profile_" .. player.UserId
end

local function onJoin(player: Player)
	local ok, stored = pcall(function()
		return store:GetAsync(keyFor(player))
	end)
	if not ok then
		-- Never start from defaults after a failed read; that would overwrite real data.
		player:Kick("Data unavailable, please rejoin")
		return
	end
	local profile: Profile = { coins = 0, level = 1 }
	if type(stored) == "table" then
		profile.coins = tonumber(stored.coins) or 0
		profile.level = tonumber(stored.level) or 1
	end
	if player.Parent then
		profiles[player] = profile
	end
end

local function persist(player: Player, profile: Profile)
	inFlight += 1
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		store:UpdateAsync(keyFor(player), function()
			return profile
		end)
	end)
	inFlight -= 1
	if not ok then
		warn("save failed for", player.UserId, err)
	end
end

-- Taking the profile out of the table before saving guarantees exactly one
-- final save, even when PlayerRemoving and BindToClose both fire on shutdown.
local function finalSave(player: Player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if profile ~= nil then
		profiles[player] = nil
		persist(player, profile)
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onJoin)
for _, alreadyHere in Players:GetPlayers() do
	task.spawn(onJoin, alreadyHere)
end
Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(finalSave)

task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(AUTOSAVE_SECONDS)
		for player, profile in profiles do
			task.spawn(persist, player, profile)
		end
	end
end)

game:BindToClose(function()
	for player in profiles do
		task.spawn(finalSave, player)
	end
	-- Also covers saves PlayerRemoving started just before shutdown.
	local giveUpAt = os.clock() + 25
	repeat
		task.wait()
	until inFlight == 0 or os.clock() > giveUpAt
end)

prompt: Implement a RemoteFunction `GetQuote` whose server handler is rate-limited to 3 calls per 10 seconds per player and cleans up its per-player state when players leave.
reference:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local WINDOW, LIMIT = 10, 3
local calls: { [Player]: { number } } = {}

local remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
remote.Name = "GetQuote"
remote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	calls[player] = nil
end)

remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player)
	local now = os.clock()
	local recent = {}
	for _, t in calls[player] or {} do
		if now - t < WINDOW then
			table.insert(recent, t)
		end
	end
	calls[player] = recent
	if #recent >= LIMIT then
		return nil
	end
	table.insert(recent, now)
	return "Stay curious."
end

prompt: Write a server-side anti-speed/teleport check. Every frame, compare each character's HumanoidRootPart movement against its Humanoid.WalkSpeed (with tolerance). On a violation, rubber-band the player back to the last valid position instead of trusting the client. Let server code whitelist its own teleports, and clean up per-player state.
reference:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local TOLERANCE = 1.5 -- multiplier on WalkSpeed for latency and physics jitter
local VERTICAL_ALLOWANCE = 60 -- studs per second for jumps and falls

type Track = { position: Vector3, serverMoveUntil: number }
local tracks: { [Player]: Track } = {}

-- Server code that teleports a player calls this so the move is not flagged.
local function allowTeleport(player: Player, seconds: number)
	local track = tracks[player]
	if track then
		track.serverMoveUntil = os.clock() + seconds
	end
end

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	tracks[player] = nil
end)

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt: number)
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			tracks[player] = nil
			continue
		end
		local track = tracks[player]
		if not track or now < track.serverMoveUntil then
			tracks[player] = { position = root.Position, serverMoveUntil = track and track.serverMoveUntil or 0 }
			continue
		end
		local delta = root.Position - track.position
		local horizontal = Vector3.new(delta.X, 0, delta.Z).Magnitude
		local maxHorizontal = humanoid.WalkSpeed * TOLERANCE * dt + 0.5
		if horizontal > maxHorizontal or math.abs(delta.Y) > VERTICAL_ALLOWANCE * dt + 0.5 then
			-- Rubber-band to the last valid position instead of trusting the client.
			root.CFrame = CFrame.new(track.position) * root.CFrame.Rotation
			root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		else
			track.position = root.Position
		end
	end
end)

return allowTeleport

Players duplicate items by spamming the trade accept button. Find the race and fix the server handler. `TradeService` (a ModuleScript next to this script) exposes `trades`, `stillOwnsItems(trade)`, `giveItems(trade)` and `saveInventories(trade)` (which yields):
```lua
local TradeService = require(script.Parent.TradeService)
game.ReplicatedStorage.TradeAccept.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player, tradeId)
	local trade = TradeService.trades[tradeId]
	trade.accepted[player] = true
	if trade.accepted[trade.a] and trade.accepted[trade.b] then
		TradeService.saveInventories(trade)
		TradeService.giveItems(trade)
	end
end)
```
reference:
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local TradeService = require(script.Parent.TradeService)
local tradeAccept = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("TradeAccept") :: RemoteEvent

tradeAccept.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, tradeId: unknown)
	if typeof(tradeId) ~= "string" then
		return
	end
	local trade = TradeService.trades[tradeId]
	if not trade or (player ~= trade.a and player ~= trade.b) then
		return -- unknown trade, or not a participant
	end
	if trade.accepted[player] then
		return
	end
	trade.accepted[player] = true
	if not (trade.accepted[trade.a] and trade.accepted[trade.b]) then
		return
	end
	-- Claim the trade BEFORE anything yields: a second accept arriving while
	-- we save would otherwise run the exchange twice and duplicate items.
	TradeService.trades[tradeId] = nil
	if not TradeService.stillOwnsItems(trade) then
		return
	end
	TradeService.giveItems(trade)
	TradeService.saveInventories(trade)
end)

prompt: Design a typed, strict-mode ModuleScript `CooldownService` with methods `new(duration)`, `:TryUse(player): boolean`, and `:Reset(player)`, using metatables, that never leaks per-player state. Instances must be destroyable without leaking connections. Instances must be destroyable without leaking connections.
reference:
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local CooldownService = {}
CooldownService.__index = CooldownService

export type CooldownService = typeof(setmetatable({} :: {
	duration: number,
	last: { [Player]: number },
	removing: RBXScriptConnection?,
}, CooldownService))

function CooldownService.new(duration: number): CooldownService
	local self = setmetatable({ duration = duration, last = {}, removing = nil :: RBXScriptConnection? }, CooldownService)
	-- Kept on the instance so Destroy can release it; an unstored connection
	-- would keep every CooldownService ever created alive.
	self.removing = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		self.last[player] = nil
	end)
	return self
end

function CooldownService.TryUse(self: CooldownService, player: Player): boolean
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - (self.last[player] or -math.huge) < self.duration then
		return false
	end
	self.last[player] = now
	return true
end

function CooldownService.Reset(self: CooldownService, player: Player)
	self.last[player] = nil
end

function CooldownService.Destroy(self: CooldownService)
	if self.removing then
		self.removing:Disconnect()
		self.removing = nil
	end
	table.clear(self.last)
end

return CooldownService

prompt: Write strict server code for a hitscan weapon with lag compensation. The client fires `FireWeapon:FireServer(origin: Vector3, direction: Vector3, clientTime: number)` where clientTime is `workspace:GetServerTimeNow()` on the client. Keep a short position history per character, rewind other characters to the (clamped) shot time, raycast on the server excluding the shooter, and reject spoofed origins, bad vectors and fire-rate abuse.
reference:
--!strict
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local HISTORY_SECONDS = 1
local MAX_REWIND = 0.4 -- never rewind further than this, whatever the client claims
local MAX_ORIGIN_OFFSET = 6
local RANGE = 300
local DAMAGE = 20
local FIRE_INTERVAL = 0.12

type Sample = { t: number, cframe: CFrame }
local history: { [Player]: { Sample } } = {}
local lastShot: { [Player]: number } = {}

local fireRemote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
fireRemote.Name = "FireWeapon"
fireRemote.Parent = ReplicatedStorage

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local character = player.Character
		local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if character and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			local samples = history[player] or {}
			history[player] = samples
			table.insert(samples, { t = now, cframe = root.CFrame })
			while #samples > 0 and now - samples[1].t > HISTORY_SECONDS do
				table.remove(samples, 1)
			end
		end
	end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
	lastShot[player] = nil
	history[player] = nil
end)

local function rootAt(target: Player, t: number): CFrame?
	local samples = history[target]
	if not samples then
		return nil
	end
	local best: Sample? = nil
	for _, sample in samples do
		if sample.t <= t then
			best = sample
		end
	end
	return if best then best.cframe else (samples[1] and samples[1].cframe)
end

fireRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, origin: unknown, direction: unknown, clientTime: unknown)
	if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(direction) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(clientTime) ~= "number" then
		return
	end
	if direction.Magnitude < 1e-3 or direction.Magnitude ~= direction.Magnitude then
		return -- zero or NaN direction
	end
	local now = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
	if now - (lastShot[player] or 0) < FIRE_INTERVAL then
		return
	end
	lastShot[player] = now
	local character = player.Character
	local head = character and character:FindFirstChild("Head")
	if not character or not head or not head:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	if (origin - head.Position).Magnitude > MAX_ORIGIN_OFFSET then
		return -- shot claimed to come from somewhere the shooter is not
	end
	local shotTime = math.clamp(clientTime, now - MAX_REWIND, now)

	-- Rewind other characters to where the shooter saw them, raycast, restore.
	local restore: { [BasePart]: CFrame } = {}
	for _, other in Players:GetPlayers() do
		local otherCharacter = other.Character
		local otherRoot = otherCharacter and otherCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if other ~= player and otherCharacter and otherRoot and otherRoot:IsA("BasePart") then
			local past = rootAt(other, shotTime)
			if past then
				restore[otherRoot] = otherRoot.CFrame
				otherRoot.CFrame = past
			end
		end
	end
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { character }
	local result = workspace:Raycast(origin, direction.Unit * RANGE, params)
	for part, cframe in restore do
		part.CFrame = cframe
	end

	local hitModel = result and result.Instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
	local humanoid = hitModel and hitModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
		humanoid:TakeDamage(DAMAGE)
	end
end)

	end,
}

-- The engine supplies `player`; any "sender" argument from the client is ignored.
adminRemote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, command: unknown, targetName: unknown)
	if not ADMINS[player.UserId] then
		warn(`Rejected admin command from non-admin {player.UserId}`)
		return
	end
	if typeof(command) ~= "string" or typeof(targetName) ~= "string" or #targetName > 20 then
		return
	end
	local handler = COMMANDS[command]
	local target = findTarget(targetName)
	if not handler or not target then
		return
	end
	print(`[audit] {player.UserId} ran {command} on {target.UserId}`)
	handler(player, target)
end)
